newsitem.title: JAPAN: Excessively strong or weak yen not good - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Excessively strong or weak yen not good - MOF.

text.p: Japan's Minister of Finance Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told reporters on Tuesday that an excessively strong or weak yen was not good for Japan and added that excessive volatility in the currency markets was also undesirable.
"Forex volatility as well as excessive yen weakness or yen strength is not good," he said.
"We must deal with such moves appropriately. We will continue to keep careful watch," he said.
Mitsuzuka added that the agreement reached by the Group of Seven nations on foreign exchange late last month had filtered through to the market.
